anomalies.obs: The ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch is implemented with T6 = AO3400A, a 30 V N-channel MOSFET, switching a 24 V inductive load (V2 DIGITEN-24V) clamped only by D3 = SS34 (40 V). The intended 60 V AON6407 device is absent from the drawing (the only AON6407-equivalent part drawn is the P-channel ADIN6407 used for reverse-polarity protection).
anomalies.expected: Spec §2 states the ATO valve is driven by 'T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET)', a 60 V device, chosen for the 24 V solenoid. A 30 V FET on a 24 V inductive rail has no headroom for switching/TVS transients (the 24 V rail is clamped at 28 V by the input TVS), so the part can avalanche and fail.

evidence.quote: ATO Valve block: T6 'AO3400A' low-side switch, D3 'SS34' flyback, load on '+24V' / V2 'DIGITEN-24V' (page 1, section E)
T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: The ATO valve MOSFET is under-rated for the 24 V inductive load; repeated switching transients can exceed its 30 V Vds absolute maximum, leading to premature failure / loss of ATO control.

anomalies.obs: The single net NET0048 ties together the PDIS (power-disable) pin of both ADM3260 isolators (U5 pin 8, U9 pin 8), the shared single-wire PD/UART pin of all three TMC2209 drivers (U4/U10/U8 pin 14), and ESP32 pin IO6 (J3.11, via R45).
anomalies.expected: Spec keeps these as two separate nets: EZO_PDIS on IO6 ('ties both U3 pin 8 and U4 pin 8 ... to a single ESP32 pin (IO6/SPI_CLK)') and the shared driver UART bus STEP_BUS on IO21/IO22. Merging the isolator PDIS inputs onto the driver UART line means any UART traffic (or driver pull) toggles the isolators' power-disable, glitching the pH/EC I2C bridges, and the PDIS inputs load the UART bus.

evidence.quote: NET0048 label on U5 pin 8 (PDIS) and U9 pin 8 (PDIS); NET0048 on U4/U10/U8 pin 14 (PD/UART); NET0048 on M5A J3.11 = IO6/SPI_CLK with R45 1k
An EZO_PDIS net ties both U3 pin 8 and U4 pin 8 (PDIS = power-disable) to a single ESP32 pin (IO6/SPI_CLK) ... STEP_BUS (shared UART) | IO21/IO22

anomalies.impact: pH/EC isolated I2C bridges are power-cycled whenever the stepper drivers communicate on the UART line, and the UART bus is loaded by the PDIS inputs; the two control functions intended to be independent are shorted together.

parsed.summary: The drawing deviates from the intended design in two ways: the ATO solenoid is switched by a 30 V AO3400A instead of the specified 60 V AON6407 (under-rated for the 24 V inductive load), and the isolator PDIS line has been merged with the shared TMC2209 single-wire UART bus onto one net (NET0048/IO6), which the specification keeps separate.
